description: Base nacional de puntos GNSS is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by IDE. Esta base de puntos GNSS (Sistema Global de Navegación por Satélite - Global Navigation Satellite System), cuenta con los puntos GCR (Ground Control Point) de Apoyo de Campo y de Control de Campo, de coberturas nacional y urbana, tomados en el marco del Proyecto “Adquisición de Imágenes Digitales de Cobertura Nacional” entre mayo de 2017 ... Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher IDE. Its tags are Global Navigation Satellite System, Ground Control Point, Puntos GCP, Puntos GNSS, Puntos de Apoyo de Campo. It offers 5 resource(s) in GEOJSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
